doors.when: Running any gh command from a hosted Desk child, which first fetches a fresh installation token so long sessions keep working
doors.confirm: This runs the real gh with a fresh installation token for the desk repository, so a write command acts on GitHub; go ahead?

errors.means: No real gh was found: DESK_REAL_GH is unset and no other gh on PATH is executable (exit 127).
errors.fix: Install gh in the image or set DESK_REAL_GH to its full path.

errors.means: DESK_TOKEN_SOCKET is not set, so the shim has no gateway to ask for a token.
errors.fix: Run it from a Desk child the gateway started, which carries DESK_TOKEN_SOCKET.

errors.means: The token socket could not be reached or did not answer within 30 seconds.
errors.fix: Check that the gateway process is still running, then rerun the gh command.

errors.means: The gateway answered but could not mint an installation token, for example because the GitHub App is not installed.
errors.fix: Read the gateway's reason in the message and fix the App's installation or key.

doors.when: Standing up or reconciling the gateway Container App (prod, or STAGE=staging), with DRY_RUN=1 first to print every change
doors.confirm: Without DRY_RUN=1 this creates or updates Azure resources (image, Container App, secrets, domain, federated credential); go ahead?

errors.means: STAGE, REMOVE_OURO_SETTINGS or DESK_GITHUB_SIGNIN holds a value the script refuses; it stops before reading Azure.
errors.fix: Pass STAGE=prod or staging, REMOVE_OURO_SETTINGS=1, or DESK_GITHUB_SIGNIN=on or off.

errors.means: az could not read the Container App or pull identity for a reason other than not found, such as an expired sign-in.
errors.fix: Run az login for the subscription and rerun.

errors.means: az 2.77's YAML update hit a Key Vault reference without a value (KeyError) and sent nothing of this update.
errors.fix: Record it for the rehearsal; the update path needs a fix before this app can be updated.

errors.means: After the update the new revision failed or was not ready within READY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS; the old revision still serves.
errors.fix: Read the new revision's logs with az containerapp logs show, fix the setting and rerun.

doors.when: Creating the ouro-desk-hooks receiver beside the gateway, or rerunning once its hooks.ouro.bot DNS records exist to bind the domain
doors.confirm: Without --dry-run this creates the ouro-desk-hooks Container App with the gateway's client key and binds its custom domain; go ahead?

errors.means: An argument other than --dry-run was given; the script exits 2 before reading Azure.
errors.fix: Pass --dry-run or nothing, and set IMAGE or HOOKS_DOMAIN in the environment.

errors.means: az could not read ouro-desk-hooks for a reason other than not found.
errors.fix: Check the az sign-in to the subscription and rerun.

errors.means: The receiver's latest revision was not ready, or /healthz did not answer 200, within READY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.
errors.fix: Read az containerapp logs show for ouro-desk-hooks, fix it and rerun.

errors.means: The CNAME or asuid TXT record for the domain is not in DNS yet, so the domain was skipped.
errors.fix: Add the two printed records in ouro.bot's DNS, DNS only, and run it again.

doors.when: Building or reconciling an Ouro tenant for test or prod, or running one action on it: Apple key import, seeding, invites, key rotations
doors.confirm: Without --dry-run this creates or changes Entra apps, roles, Key Vault secrets, Container App settings and GitHub environment variables; go ahead?

errors.means: Entra still refuses the admin app's secret this run just made.
errors.fix: Run it again in a few minutes; the secret stays in the macOS keychain.

doors.when: Daily expiry checks on the tenant's Entra and Apple secrets and the legacy cutoff, or renewing or recording the Apple key slot
doors.confirm: With --renew-apple or --record-apple-upload this PATCHes the tenant's Apple provider or writes Key Vault tags; go ahead?

errors.means: az's current account, or the admin app's token, is not in this env's Ouro tenant; nothing else was checked.
errors.fix: Sign az in to the tenant the identity record names, or pass --admin-app on the operator's machine.

errors.means: The Entra client secret or the Apple client secret ends within 30 days.
errors.fix: Rotate it: provision-identity.mjs --rotate entra-secret, or --renew-apple for Apple.

errors.means: The serving revision maps GitHub accounts but no release is recorded and DESK_LEGACY_CUTOFF is not set.
errors.fix: Record the release and set the legacy cutoff through provision.sh.

errors.means: An Apple key slot doesn't match its recorded Key ID or import fingerprint, so nothing was sent.
errors.fix: Reimport that slot's key with provision-identity.mjs --apple-key-file and --apple-key-slot.

doors.when: Before pushing a package-lock.json change, to confirm every tracked lockfile installs only from the public npm registry

errors.means: A tracked lockfile has packages that resolve outside registry.npmjs.org; the line names the lockfile and the packages; exit 1.
errors.fix: Run node hosted/infra/normalize-lockfile.mjs <path> on that lockfile, then check again.

errors.means: hosted/package-lock.json has packages without a sha512 integrity hash; the line names them; exit 1.
errors.fix: Run node hosted/infra/normalize-lockfile.mjs hosted/package-lock.json, which rewrites their integrity, then check again.

doors.when: Starting the Hosted Desk gateway, which the container runs; the settings come from its environment
doors.confirm: This starts the gateway, which signs people in and pushes desk changes to GitHub; go ahead?

errors.means: The gateway could not start: a required setting is missing or inconsistent, or a dependency it needs at start failed; the line says which; exit 1.
errors.fix: Fix the setting or dependency the line names (hosted/README.md lists them), then start it again.

errors.means: The gateway got SIGTERM or SIGINT and could not stop cleanly, for example its last desk push failed; exit 1.
errors.fix: Read the reason on the line, check the desk repository for an unpushed change, then restart the app.

doors.when: Starting the hooks receiver, which the container runs; the settings come from its environment
doors.confirm: This starts the receiver, which stores signed events from outside senders; go ahead?

errors.means: The receiver could not start: DESK_CLIENT_KEY, DESK_GITHUB_ACCOUNTS, DESK_ACCOUNTS_ENDPOINT or DESK_HOOKS_PUBLIC_URL is missing or wrong, or its tables could not be created; exit 1.
errors.fix: Set what the line names (the public url must be an https origin), then start it again.

doors.when: Git asking a hosted Desk child for github.com credentials, which come from the gateway's token socket

errors.means: The gateway's token socket could not give a token: DESK_TOKEN_SOCKET is unset, the gateway is unreachable, or it could not mint one; exit 1.
errors.fix: Run git from a Desk child the gateway started, check the gateway is running, then retry.

doors.when: Git asking for github.com credentials with the `get` action

errors.means: The gateway's token socket could not give a token: DESK_TOKEN_SOCKET is unset, the gateway is unreachable, or it could not mint one; exit 1.
errors.fix: Run git from a Desk child the gateway started, check the gateway is running, then retry.

doors.when: Building the Container App document for an `az containerapp update --yaml`, or checking the app after the write

errors.means: A required option is missing or an option is not NAME=value; exit 1.
errors.fix: Run it with --shown <show.json> --out <dir> and NAME=value settings.

errors.means: A setting is not allowed: DESK_GITHUB_SIGNIN is not on or off, Ouro settings clash with a removal, or the gateway would refuse the Ouro settings; nothing was sent to the app; exit 1.
errors.fix: Fix the setting the line names, or complete the identity record, then run it again.

errors.means: The update would be unsafe: a secret would change kind, a reference has no secret behind it, or the app holds a production identity; nothing was sent; exit 1.
errors.fix: Do what the line says (for example write the value to Key Vault, or point the registry at the stage's identity), then run it again.

errors.means: After the write, the app lost a secret, a Key Vault reference, an identity or its registry; exit 1.
errors.fix: Fix the app as the line says before it restarts, then check again.

doors.when: Writing the hooks receiver's Container App document from the gateway's, when provisioning the receiver

errors.means: The gateway lacks a setting, DESK_CLIENT_KEY secret, identity or registry identity the receiver copies; exit 1.
errors.fix: Turn on Ouro sign-in as hosted/README.md says, then provision again.

errors.means: --public-url is not an https origin; exit 1.
errors.fix: Pass the receiver's https origin, such as https://hooks.desk.ouro.bot.

errors.means: The client key file is empty or holds whitespace; exit 1.
errors.fix: Write the key on one line with no spaces, then run it again.

doors.when: Creating the Ouro Desk GitHub App from its manifest and storing its secrets, once per environment
doors.confirm: This creates a GitHub App in the organization, writes its secrets to the Container App and restarts it; go ahead?

errors.means: GitHub refused a step: the manifest code, its conversion or the installation lookup; the line has the status; exit 1.
errors.fix: Run it again from a browser signed in as an organization owner; if it repeats, check the status the line names.

errors.means: A command it runs (az or gh) failed; the line has its first words and stderr; exit 1.
errors.fix: Fix what the stderr says, such as login or access, then run it again.

errors.means: The app has no ready revision to restart, so it would not read the new secrets; exit 1.
errors.fix: Wait for or deploy a revision, then restart the app.

errors.means: The App was not installed on the repository within the wait; exit 1.
errors.fix: Install the App on the repository, then run it again.

doors.when: Rewriting a package-lock.json so every package resolves from registry.npmjs.org with sha512 integrity

errors.means: A tarball did not match the registry's published shasum, so no integrity was computed; the line names it; exit 1.
errors.fix: Retry; if it repeats, check the package on the registry before trusting the lockfile.

errors.means: A tarball download did not answer 200; the line has the status; exit 1.
errors.fix: Retry when the registry is reachable.

errors.means: `npm view` failed for a package; the line has its message; exit 1.
errors.fix: Check the network and the package name, then run it again.

doors.when: Checking that one hosted Desk connection keeps working: connect, refresh its tokens and call a tool
doors.confirm: The task-update command writes a note on a desk task through the connection; go ahead?

errors.means: A command, option or --name is missing or wrong; exit 2.
errors.fix: Run it as the usage line shows.

errors.means: No saved probe has that name; exit 1.
errors.fix: Run connect --url <mcp url> --name <name> first.

errors.means: The gateway refused to refresh the tokens, for example invalid_grant; the file is unchanged; exit 1.
errors.fix: Run connect again to sign in afresh.

errors.means: The tool call or connection failed; the line has the reason; exit 1.
errors.fix: Read the reason, check the gateway, then retry.
